parameters.query:
SELECT t.token, t.full_name AS patient_name, t.test_type, t.test_version, t.status, t.sex
FROM tokens t
WHERE t.token = $1
  AND (t.expires_at IS NULL OR t.expires_at > NOW())
LIMIT 1

UPDATE tokens
SET status = 'completed', used_at = NOW()
WHERE token = $1 AND status = 'processing'

INSERT INTO results
  (submission_id, token, full_name, test_type, answers,
   score, severity, status, scoring_time_ms, n8n_execution_id, details)
VALUES
  ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb,
   $6, $7, 'scored', $8, $9, $10::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (submission_id) DO UPDATE
  SET updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, token

parameters.query:
UPDATE results 
SET status = 'notified', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE submission_id = $1::uuid
INSERT INTO error_logs (n8n_execution_id, node_name, error_message, input_data) VALUES ($1, 'Scoring/DB Error', $2, $3::jsonb)

parameters.query:
UPDATE tokens
SET status = 'processing', used_at = NOW()
WHERE token = $1
  AND expires_at > NOW()
  AND (status = 'pending'
       OR (status = 'processing' AND used_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'))
RETURNING token, full_name, status

UPDATE tokens
SET status = 'pending', used_at = NULL
WHERE token = $1 AND status = 'processing'
